label: PF Backlog 523
title: Backlog index.html: epic-wise classification (per-epic counts + Epic column)
body:
## Problem / why
`data/backlog/index.html` (core/views.py) listed items without showing which EPIC each item belongs to, nor how many items each epic has.

## Goal & value
Add an 'By epic' summary (title + open/closed/total per epic) and an Epic column to the item table so the backlog can be reviewed epic-wise.

brief.problem: The backlog HTML had no epic-wise view or per-epic counts.
brief.what_adds: epic + epic_title per row; an 'By epic' summary table; an Epic column.
brief.why: Review the backlog by epic (what belongs to which epic, and how many).

objective: Add epic classification to the generated backlog HTML: per-row epic + epic_title fields, an 'By epic' summary table (open/closed/total), and an Epic column.
acceptance_criteria: render_backlog_html() includes a 'By epic' summary with per-epic open/closed/total
the item table gains an Epic column
test covers the epic fields + the summary/column markup
approach: Add epic/epic_title to the row projection (title map from all items); compute a per-epic summary in Python; add the summary block + an Epic column to the rendered HTML/JS.

prior_decisions: backlog is SSOT; derived files are generated (docs/AGENTS)
assumptions: title map from the same scope

verification: regenerated data/backlog/index.html contains 'By epic' + Epic column

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/backlog.py, core/backlog_link.py, core/id_index.py, /api/v1/backlog
